stemMd: A circle lies in a coordinate plane of an isometric projection, with that plane oblique to the image plane. What is its projected shape?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A circle of the same radius

explanationMd: Parallel projection maps the circle in the oblique plane to an ellipse. One can understand this as direction-dependent compression within the plane. It does not produce an unbounded conic or polygon.

distractorRationale.a: An oblique plane is foreshortened in one in-plane direction.
distractorRationale.e: Parallel projection of a bounded circle remains bounded.
distractorRationale.d: Projection does not convert the smooth boundary to three edges.
distractorRationale.c: A bounded circle does not project to an unbounded curve.
